suggestion: Adopt a licensed-operator price feed as the single market-price source
options: A: licensed operator API with terms; B: operator public odds page captured on schedule; C: no market prices until terms are read
recommendation: Option A if terms permit automated capture; otherwise B with a dated capture schedule
what_would_change_our_mind: A terms review showing automated capture is permitted and the schema is stable

suggestion: Pre-register the 136-game backtest corpus in git before use
options: A: freeze full-season log now; B: freeze only after price policy is decided
recommendation: Option A - the corpus is official results and does not depend on the price policy
what_would_change_our_mind: A reviewer finding a defect in the frozen corpus (corrected by a new pre-registered commit, never silently)

suggestion: Build the depth-chart register club-by-club with a verified route
options: A: per-club official depth pages verified club-by-club; B: official snap counts; C: both with conflict flags
recommendation: Option A first, then B as a cross-check; do not build the deficiency feature until one route verifies for all 32 clubs
what_would_change_our_mind: A club page that cannot be parsed by the chosen route after two attempts (then switch routes and re-register)

suggestion: Schedule immutable Wed/Thu/Fri injury captures with hashes
options: A: cron-style GitHub Action on Wed/Thu/Fri; B: manual dated captures; C: daily capture Wed-to-kickoff
recommendation: Option A - automation is the only way to build the timestamped series the brief requires
what_would_change_our_mind: A source change (schema/URL) that breaks the capture - the drift alarm should catch it and alert

suggestion: Compute designation reliability (play-rate per designation) before use as a feature
options: A: multi-season designation-to-inactive join; B: single-season pilot first
recommendation: Option B as a pilot, then A once the pilot shows the join is complete
what_would_change_our_mind: A pilot showing designations do not separate play rates (then the label is dropped as a feature)

suggestion: Split the repo into a public analysis layer and a private raw-data layer
options: A: private store with derived public exports; B: keep public but label raw rows clearly
recommendation: Option A once raw row-level data grows; until then keep the current fully-public desk with provenance links
what_would_change_our_mind: A data-volume or sensitivity review finding raw rows must not be public

suggestion: Publish the removal-of-luck panel as soon as the first 200 bets settle
options: A: panel on the landing page; B: panel on the leaderboard page only
recommendation: Option A - the brief asks for it on the site dashboard
what_would_change_our_mind: A the gate analysis showing no skill after 200 bets (panel then reports that honestly)

suggestion: Add a drift alarm to every scraper (row counts + required fields)
options: A: fail-closed verify in CI; B: alert-only
recommendation: Option A - the desk verify script already fails closed; extend the pattern to every scraper
what_would_change_our_mind: A source legitimately changing its schema (then update the pinned expectations with a reviewed commit)

suggestion: Run injury/depth ablations instead of fixed penalties
options: A: with/without availability features on chronological holdouts; B: fixed penalties as a fallback
recommendation: Option A - the brief explicitly rejects fixed penalties
what_would_change_our_mind: A an ablation showing the availability features add no signal (then they are removed, not penalized)

suggestion: Publish every model total twice until one wins
options: A: two independent estimators with a gap column; B: single estimator
recommendation: Option A once a second estimator is pre-registered
what_would_change_our_mind: A a walk-forward comparison showing one estimator dominates (then collapse to it with a recorded decision)

suggestion: Add a weekly 'what changed' diff page
options: A: dated snapshots + diff columns; B: static snapshot only
recommendation: Option A - required for the timestamped-series requirement
what_would_change_our_mind: A two consecutive weeks with no diff (then the page reports 'no change' explicitly)

suggestion: Use proper-score qualification before any prospective CLV/ROI escrow
recommendation: Option A - aligns incentives with calibrated probabilistic skill
what_would_change_our_mind: A a qualified strategy failing the prospective stage (then it is demoted to paper per gate G10)
